title: Leaked GTA 6 Walkthrough Details a Wild Police Ambush

lines.text: A full GTA 6 mission walkthrough just leaked online.
lines.label: MISSION LEAKED?
lines.ai_prompt: glowing classified video game dossier folders on a dark hacker desk

lines.text: GTA Boom published detailed steps for a Chapter 3 job called Bricked Up.
lines.label: CHAPTER 3 MISSION

lines.text: According to the report, this story mission starts in Bayside.
lines.label: STARTING IN BAYSIDE
lines.subject: Leonida Map Poster

lines.text: You meet an associate named Boobie to make a delivery.
lines.label: MEET BOOBIE
lines.subject: Boobie Ike

lines.text: Jason drives to Venture Apartments, but a police raid hits the building.
lines.label: POLICE RAID HITS
lines.subject: Jason Duval

lines.text: To secure a thirty-five hundred dollar payout, you must grab a red bag.
lines.label: $3,500 RED BAG

lines.text: But escaping on foot gets cut off by police in the stairwells.
lines.label: STAIRWELL BLOCKED

lines.text: Here's the twist: seamless character swapping instantly kicks in.
lines.label: CHARACTER SWAP
lines.ai_prompt: split screen dynamic cinematic action perspective shift between two heist partners

lines.text: Control immediately switches outside to Lucia in the parking lot.
lines.label: CONTROL SWITCHES
lines.subject: Lucia Caminos

lines.text: She steals a getaway vehicle and speeds directly beneath Jason's window.
lines.label: GETAWAY VEHICLE
lines.subject: Jason And Lucia

lines.text: Jason drops in, and a police helicopter begins an intense pursuit.
lines.label: WINDOW EXTRACTION
lines.subject: Jason Lucia Lock And Load

lines.text: The guide reveals you have to dodge roadblocks to escape the search zone.
lines.label: CHOPPER PURSUIT

lines.text: The wild getaway finally wraps up at the Jack of Hearts club.
lines.label: JACK OF HEARTS

lines.text: Rockstar hasn't confirmed these leaked details yet.
lines.label: NOT CONFIRMED
lines.subject: Vice City

lines.text: Does this sound like an actual GTA 6 mission to you?
lines.label: REAL OR FAKE?
lines.subject: Cover Art

description: An alleged GTA 6 mission walkthrough titled 'Bricked Up' details a tense police ambush, dual-protagonist extraction, and a high-speed chase. Here is a breakdown of what the guide claims happens.
